'''''Revelator''''' was a [[Lictor-class dungeon ship|''Lictor''-class dungeon ship]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
It accompanied [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] on a mission to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
